# Routine Streaks 1.2.3

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed Scriptable widgets showing a 1-day streak when today's routine is only partially completed.
- Scriptable widgets now display streak and today progress from the exported `data.json` instead of recalculating streaks on-device.

## Improvements

- Added exported incomplete state to `data.json`, including incomplete routine counts and routine IDs.
- Added per-routine `todayIncompleteTaskCount` to the exported cache data.

## Notes

- After updating, regenerate the Scriptable widget code from the plugin settings and export `data.json` again.
